summary: On the main deck, Morpheus is in tears as he reaches for the EMP switch. Trinity leans to Neo and whispers in his ear, begging him to listen because she promised to tell him the rest. She recounts that the Oracle told her she would fall in love and that the man she loved would be the one, and she insists Neo cannot be dead because she loves him, declaring her love. She closes her eyes and kisses him, believing with all her heart that he will feel her lips and know they speak the truth.

what_changes.before: Keeping her feelings for Neo unspoken, having only promised to tell him the rest later.
what_changes.after: She openly declares her love for Neo, insisting he cannot be dead because she loves him.
what_changes.evidence: You see?  You can't be dead, Neo, you can't be because I love you.  You hear me?  I love you!

what_changes.before: Whispering to a seemingly dead Neo, pleading for him to listen.
what_changes.after: She kisses him, fully believing he will feel her lips and know they speak the truth.
what_changes.evidence: Her eyes close and she kisses him, believing in all her heart that he will feel her lips and know that they speak the truth.

event_hint.one_line: As Morpheus prepares to trigger the EMP, Trinity confesses her love to Neo and kisses him.

uncertain: Whether Neo actually hears or feels Trinity's declaration and kiss.
Whether Trinity's declaration changes Neo's physical condition within this scene.
